beats.say: Guess what share of India's firecrackers come from just one town.
It's Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu. Over a thousand licensed factories. About three lakh workers.
lines: Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu. About 3 lakh workers.

beats.say: Seven thousand crore a year, and most of it sells around Diwali.
lines: Most of it sold around Diwali

beats.say: Wait, it gets better. This Diwali, crackers cost thirty to fifty percent more.
Why? At one point, sulphur jumped from seventy-five rupees a kilo to one forty.
lines: Up from ₹75. Raw materials up about 30%.

beats.say: The answer? About eighty-five to ninety percent. Nearly nine in ten. Did you guess right? Comment below.
lines: Nearly 9 in 10. Did you guess right?
